Trusted Partner for

Stingray is a comprehensive customer-centric IT & Telco solutions and services provider, offering a wide range of services and solutions across multiple domains including IT, Telecom, Healthcare, and more.

Headquartered in the UK with offices spanning the Middle East and beyond, Stingray combines traditional values with progressive ideas and positive result-oriented action.

08AI & Machine Learning

SAILOR AI

Self-learning AI & ML models enabling autonomous assurance, evolving from human-dependent monitoring to AI-driven proactive detection, prediction, and automated actions.

SAILOR AI Agents
sailor.assure

Risk assessment, control design, impact analysis, persistent AI agent that learns your processes

sailor.analytics

Natural language to data, ask questions, get instant structured results and auto-generated dashboards

sailor.automate

GenAI-supervised automation, AI decides what to automate based on its own analysis, not predefined rules

sailor.impact

Instant impact analysis across all controls and rules, identifies needed modifications automatically

Predictive ML

From detection to prediction, anomaly detection, pattern recognition, and proactive loss prevention

Supervised GenAI

Same maturity, same output, every time, all results stored in DB for analysis and further threads

ML-Powered Capabilities
Predictive Analytics

Forecast risks, schedule slippage, vendor risk, and budget overruns

Anomaly Detection

Auto-detect violations, breaches, and suspicious patterns in real-time

Automated Actions

Auto-open cases, apply corrective actions, trigger preventive measures

Fraud Scoring

ML-powered fraud scoring with graph intelligence and pattern recognition

Natural Language Queries

Analysts query databases using plain language for instant results

Auto Rule Optimization

Self-tuning business rules with ML feedback loop
